Titles.eng: Yo-kai Watch 6: Can a Cat Be a Hero?
Titles.jpn: 映画 妖怪ウォッチ 妖怪学園Y 猫はHEROになれるか

Summaries.eng: Set in Y-Academy, an elite school that only allows students with top class abilities to enter. The protagonist, Jinpei Jiba, and his unique friends take on the mysteries of the school as transforming heroes.
